decision: Retain compact descriptions as a development candidate; reject terse for promotion. Compact passed the frozen development gate but still lost to grep/read on observed accuracy and tokens. No production change without fresh held-out replication.

protocol.purpose: Paired description-only ablation on current production, including all three correctness repairs.
protocol.fixed_contract: Same tool names/order/input schemas, native tools, retrieval implementation, prompts, source checkouts, full history and sequential calls. Only five PASR tool descriptions differ.
protocol.budget: No retries or fallback; reserve before sending; stop on unknown usage. All profiles freshly executed.
protocol.primary: Compact@6 and terse@6 versus production@6: full-answer accuracy, paired transitions, cumulative input+output tokens. Baseline@4 and @6 remain external controls.
protocol.promotion_gate: No automatic production promotion: require lower mean tokens, no observed net accuracy loss versus production, and paired 95% accuracy-difference lower bound above -0.05. Report multiplicity and reused-data limits even if gate passes; fresh held-out replication required before shipping.
protocol.grading: Arm-blind coding-assistant source review using frozen corrected replication rubric; each answer independently graded. Not independent human validation.
protocol.analysis: All failures in denominator; question and repository-cluster bootstrap intervals; exact catalog deltas measured from first provider requests; report cache dollars separately from logical tokens.
protocol.reuse_disclosure: These 50 questions were already used in local and OpenAI studies. This is development ablation, not unseen validation. No accuracy credit inferred from the earlier pre-fix study.

compact.find_files: Find files by lexical path/filename terms, not content. Use known module, file or directory names; for behavior questions without names use find_evidence. include scopes globs/directories; empty query lists files. Returns real paths for select_context. No max_files limit.
compact.find_symbols: Find symbol definitions across the workspace (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Rust). Exact names return exact matches; otherwise ranks similar names. Returns file:line locators, not bodies. Use select_context to read definitions; find_usages for callers.
compact.find_evidence: Start here for behavior questions without known paths or symbols. Search file content by query terms, ranked by rarity; returns matching lines and enclosing definitions, not bodies. No max_files limit. Read a hit with select_context(query=..., files=[provenance path]); add :read_lines only for that exact bounded span.
compact.find_usages: Find symbol uses across the workspace, definitions first then call sites. Returns matching lines and enclosing definitions, not bodies. For behavior across a call chain. Read hits with select_context(query=..., files=[provenance path + ":" + read_lines]); read_lines bounds the enclosing function or nearby lines.
compact.select_context: Read query-relevant source with file:line provenance, at most 1500 tokens per reply. Scope to known files or include globs/directories; discover real paths first, since guesses error and broad scopes can exceed max_files. Prefer small early budgets. outline=true returns definitions only. files accepts path:start-end for exact lines. Already delivered lines are omitted; another call adds unread source.

terse.find_files: Find files by path/filename terms, not content. include scopes globs/directories; empty query lists paths. Use find_evidence for behavior questions.
terse.find_symbols: Find exact or similar symbol definitions workspace-wide. Returns file:line locators; read bodies with select_context.
terse.find_evidence: Search file content by query terms. Start here for behavior questions. Returns matching lines and definitions; read bodies with select_context files=[provenance path].
terse.find_usages: Find symbol definitions and uses workspace-wide. Returns matching lines and enclosing definitions. Read with select_context files=[provenance path + ":" + read_lines].
terse.select_context: Read query-relevant source from known files or include globs/directories; do not guess paths. Maximum 1500 tokens, file:line labels, no repeated lines. files accepts path:start-end; outline=true lists definitions.

source_grading.method: Arm-blind coding-assistant source review using frozen corrected replication rubric; each answer independently graded. Not independent human validation.
source_grading.consistency_rule: Criterion support, missing/error presence and complete agree; rationale wording and exact quote choice need not match.

grading_clarifications.scope: Clarifications of the frozen grading_standards.json omission/materiality rules, made during arm-blind review and applied to all answers for each question. Criteria support means substantive requested scope, not every incidental rubric clause.

clarifications.question: What happens when an already-registered plugin name is blocked and later unblocked? Trace removal of its hook implementations, the blocked-name representation, and whether unblocking restores the original plugin.
clarifications.decision: A separate register-under-blocked-name attempt and its exact None return are not asked. Do not fail an otherwise complete marker/removal/non-restoration answer for omitting that incidental rubric clause. Use the exact blocked-marker quote and state the scope limitation in its rationale; volunteered false registration behavior remains material. Apply equally to all five answers.

Ordinary empty-input wording is interpreted in context, not expanded into a universal assertion about truthy empty generators. An explicit false universal branch claim would be material. Source-checksum mismatch establishes stale-source rejection; additional magic/corruption checks are not mandatory unless requested or volunteered falsely.

grading_clarifications.review_isolation: Early review preparation exposed shared Eval globals across workers. No wrong-corpus review was accepted; workers were instructed to reread assigned files with local-function variables or direct reads, discard contaminated drafts, and verify all identities against assigned packets. Final integration validates every identity, answer quote, criterion, and duplicate-answer consistency.

statistical_contract.accuracy_unit: fraction, candidate minus control; all 50 questions including failed generations
statistical_contract.token_estimand: ratio of paired cumulative input+output sums (equivalently means), not mean individual ratios
statistical_contract.question_resampling: 50 paired questions sampled with replacement; same draw stream for all comparisons
statistical_contract.cluster_resampling: 10 repositories sampled with replacement; all paired questions in each selected repository retained
statistical_contract.multiplicity: Unadjusted marginal 95% intervals, not simultaneous or family-wise confidence; candidates share controls.
statistical_contract.gate_interval: Question-paired percentile interval; repository-cluster result reported separately as sensitivity.

semantic_execution_audit.scope: All executed select_context advanced arguments audited. This supports a request-level statement, not process-level proof that no local model was ever loaded. Hashing is not a learned embedding model.

limitations: These 50 questions were already used in local and OpenAI studies. This is development ablation, not unseen validation. No accuracy credit inferred from the earlier pre-fix study.
250 trajectories are not 250 independent questions: five profiles reuse each of 50 questions; ten repository clusters.
Two description candidates were evaluated on the same development data. Selection among candidates and multiple comparisons can overstate apparent gains.
One model configuration, one repetition, ten Python repositories; no universal, unseen-data, cross-language or independent-human-validation claim.
Exploratory bootstrap intervals reflect resampling this convenience sample, not a population noninferiority guarantee; only ten clusters limits cluster uncertainty.
Equal estimates, zero observed net loss, or a gate pass do not establish equivalence; gains and losses may cancel and transitions remain visible.
All failed generations stay in the accuracy and token denominators; no accuracy credit is borrowed from pre-fix runs.

Pre-run hashes cover the production snapshot, frozen harness/runner/rubric files and listed rubric evidence files only, not every searchable file in the repository checkouts. Any full-tree snapshot captured after execution began cannot establish an unchanged full checkout from before the run.
The select_context advanced semantic audit reports requested modes. A minilm request can load a local embedding model; request logs alone cannot prove or disprove loading.
Cached input remains in logical token totals. Dollars use frozen published rates or conservative bounds, not an invoice; source-review compute is excluded.
No automatic promotion. Fresh held-out replication is required before shipping.
